text:
violet (Finance): FYI overnight alert: Dedicated GPU spend in us-west2 jumped ~20% and the cost UI shows a big UNASSIGNED bucket. https://billing.internal/redwood/costs?range=24h

costwatch-bot: :bulb: Anomaly detected: pool 'dedicated-ephemeral' +19.8% vs baseline. Notifying #finance #eng-platform

noah (FinOps): Pulled billing export. A set of instances from project trial-halo-77 lack billing labels (team / cost_center). Quick back-of-envelope is ~USD 10.2k for the last 9h.

ana (Platform): That project used the new ephemeral onboarding path deployed yesterday. Looks like one codepath didn't attach billing metadata when creating dedicated instances. I'm rolling a hotfix now.

violet (Finance): Can we reassign those costs to the trial so Finance can decide whether to invoice or absorb? We need an exact list and timestamps for the customer.

noah (FinOps): Backfill plan (dry-run first): 1) enumerate instance IDs from the export 2) add labels via gcloud 3) re-run billing ingestion for the affected window. Example commands:  
```
bq query --nouse_legacy_sql '\nSELECT resource.labels.instance_id FROM `billing_export.gcp_resource_usage` WHERE project_id="trial-halo-77" AND usage_start_time > TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 12 HOUR)'\n
```
and then:  
```
for id in $(cat instance_ids.txt); do\n  gcloud compute instances add-labels $id --labels=team=halo,cost_center=trial-halo --project=trial-halo-77 --zone=us-west2-a --quiet\ndone
```
I'll wait for Sales/Legal sign-off before touching customer project metadata.

hugo (Sales): I have the customer contact. Trial terms say we can manage infra but must not bill without notice. I'll request written permission for bookkeeping attribution and paste the redacted reply here.

meera (Legal): Please get a short email from the customer permitting us to tag resources for internal billing attribution. If they decline, we can't modify their project metadata.

hugo (Sales): Customer replied (redacted): "Ok to attribute trial infra to Halo for internal review. We expect notice before any charge." Attached to ticket #TR-77.

noah (FinOps): Received. Preparing instance list now. After Legal OK, I'll run the dry-run add-labels in staging, then apply in prod and trigger ingestion backfill. Will post exact instance IDs and the backfill job link.

ana (Platform): Hotfix merged to onboarding service to default billing labels in the ephemeral path: https://git.internal/onboarding/pull/712. Also added short-term alert 'dedicated-unlabeled-launch' to notify #finance and oncall.

costwatch-bot: Deploy succeeded: onboarding-service v1.3.1 at 03:33 UTC

violet (Finance): Finance will hold invoice decisions until we reconcile. Please cc finance on the backfill job and attach customer permission to the invoice draft when ready. Marking thread for follow-up until backfill + attribution complete. :white_check_mark:
